children.innerHTML:
Objects and their apps,
drawn in Ghent.
Ilse Marten designs for small brands, from first sketch to factory.
“Make a lamp for people who read paper at a screen desk.”
Three heads went to the bench. The ring shipped: light on the page, not the screen.
